classification_vocabulary.CONFIRMED: supported by explicit identifiers/references or an observed absence plus an explicit reference
classification_vocabulary.POSSIBLE: plausible association (same node/component, tight timing, or concurrent activity) but not provable from the records
classification_vocabulary.UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: temporal proximity or a missing cause; causation / cause is not established by the available records
classification_vocabulary.SHOULD_NOT_BE_CORRELATED: events that must not be merged, linked or described as causally related

note: The logs contain no causal field. 'causal_certainty' is evaluation metadata only.
